note.explanation: Biodiversity describes the variety of organisms in a particular area. It is measured by counting the different kinds of organisms and considering the variation within each kind. Biodiversity is important because it supports ecosystem stability, helps regulate climate, provides natural resources, and supports industries.
examples: A tropical region has more biodiversity than a polar region.
Plants and algae absorb carbon dioxide, helping to keep the climate balanced.
note.checkAnswer: Biodiversity is the variety of organisms in a particular area.
note.simple: Biodiversity means how many different kinds of living things live in a place, and how much they vary.

note.title: Biodiversity
steps: Consider the number of different kinds of organisms there.

note.answer: Biodiversity is the variety of organisms in a particular area.

options: The variety of organisms in a particular area
The number of rocks in an area

rationales: This is correct because biodiversity means the variety of organisms in a particular area.

options: Plants and algae absorb carbon dioxide.
Plants and algae produce building materials directly.
Plants and algae stop all changes in climate.
Plants and algae reduce the number of organisms in an ecosystem.
mcqs.stem: How do plants and algae help regulate climate?
rationales: This is correct because plants and algae absorb carbon dioxide, helping to keep the climate balanced.
This is incorrect because the section mentions building materials as a resource biodiversity provides, not as the way plants and algae regulate climate.

options: It maintains ecosystem balance and supports biogeochemical cycles.
It removes all carbon and nitrogen from ecosystems.
It prevents organisms from interacting.
It makes every ecosystem identical.
mcqs.stem: How does biodiversity contribute to ecosystem stability?
rationales: This is correct because biodiversity helps maintain ecosystem balance and plays an important role in cycles such as the carbon and nitrogen cycles.
This is incorrect because biodiversity supports biogeochemical cycles rather than removing all carbon and nitrogen.
This is incorrect because the section does not say biodiversity prevents organisms from interacting.
This is incorrect because biodiversity varies between places and does not make ecosystems identical.

options: Food and medicine
Only sunlight and rain
Only air and soil
Nothing useful to humans

rationales: This is correct because the section lists food and medicine among the resources provided by biodiversity.
This is incorrect because sunlight and rain are not the pair of biodiversity resources listed in the section.

explain.title: Meaning of biodiversity
explain.body: Biodiversity means the variety of organisms in a particular area.

explain.title: Measuring biodiversity
explain.body: Biodiversity of an area is measured by considering the number of different kinds of organisms and the variation within each kind.

explain.title: Where biodiversity is found
explain.body: Biodiversity is not evenly spread out. It depends on factors such as climate, altitude, and soil type. Tropical regions have more biodiversity than polar regions.

explain.title: Why biodiversity matters
explain.body: Biodiversity helps maintain ecosystem balance and supports carbon and nitrogen cycles. Plants and algae absorb carbon dioxide, and biodiversity also provides resources and supports industries.

mistakes: Do not define biodiversity only as the total number of organisms; include the variety of kinds and variation within each kind.
Do not say biodiversity is evenly spread across Earth; it varies between places.
Do not reverse the comparison: tropical regions have more biodiversity than polar regions.
When explaining importance, do not give only human resources; include benefits to ecosystems or climate too.
